# 2 Baruch Chapter 25 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**25:1** And he answered and said to me: You also will be preserved until that time — until the sign which the Most High will perform for the inhabitants of the earth at the end of days.

**25:2** This therefore will be the sign: when terror and confusion seize the inhabitants of the earth, and they fall into many tribulations and are cast into great torments —

**25:3** And it will come to pass that when they say in their hearts, because of their many afflictions: The Mighty One no longer remembers the earth — then it will come.

**25:4** And at that time, when the Most High is about to visit the world which he made, he will command a sign against the nations, and many tribulations will come upon them.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "preserved" (v.1) over EMET's "kept" — LOGOS/PNEUMA both use more active language; "inhabitants of the earth" (v.2) retained as it is 2 Baruch's standard phrase for humanity; "say in their hearts" (v.3) over PNEUMA's "cry out in their hearts" — the Syriac indicates internal thought rather than vocal expression.*
